items.claim: Billy Ray Goff has good recovery and has bounced back after being rocked in past fights.
items.quote: Billy Ray Golf's recovery is pretty good. He's been rocked before and he's came back from it.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff possesses dangerous close-range boxing with high output and confidence.
items.quote: his close-range boxing is dangerous with the high output and confidence that he's throwing all these shots with.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff has good durability and has never actually been flatline knocked out before.
items.quote: He's never actually been like flatline KO'ed before and he seems to have pretty good durability.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff struggles with distance against Tai Miller due to being shorter with a substantial reach disadvantage.
items.quote: golf struggles with the distance of Tai Miller 4 in shorter with a pretty substantial 5-in reach disadvantage too

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff does not present a massive wrestling threat.
items.quote: I don't feel there is a massive wrestling threat from Billy Ray Goff

items.claim: Tai Miller will likely outstrike Billy Ray Goff in a wild fight.
items.quote: Tai Miller life to out strike him in a wild fight.

items.claim: Tai Miller has superior standup and boxing prowess compared to Billy Ray Goff.
items.quote: I'm going to trust in Ty Miller's boxing. I think his standup is superior
